ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dominant dark-pigmented (black) surface area and high-intensity (white) linear and punctate anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pixel base across the entire visible surface. Distinct white linear streaks concentrated on the mid-left lobe. High-intensity circular clusters (barnacle colonies) localized at the terminal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with an acute internal angle approximately 45-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire continuous trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters at the far left and right fluke margins, consistent with barnacle colonization. Numerous smaller, isolated white circular spots scattered across both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple prominent, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions visible, primarily horizontal and diagonal on the left lobe, and several shorter, unaligned marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at the distal tips; significant linear rake-like scarring across the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Widespread distribution of small, circular white 'pockmark' scars across the central and right lobes, distinct from the larger linear marks.
